senses.gloss: m. (νάρθηξ) [narthex, a small umbelliferous plant with a hollow pithy stalk, which may be used as a receptacle; in gen.] case, casket.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:3">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵇ</cite> top <he>נַרְתֵּיקוֹ של רופא</he> a physician’s medicine chest.
